runtime.command_template: python tools/run_pinmame_harness.py --library <libpinmame> --game nba_600 --rom-path <vpinmame-roms> --work-dir <new-isolated-state> --handle-mechanics 0 --ready-timeout 90 --scenario tools/harness-scenarios/stern/nba-2009-coil-sweep.json --dmd-dir <external-dmd-dir> --output <external-run.json>. SELECT energizes the coil on display. The selector steps #1-#32 in order and wraps to #1 at position 33. Firing #6 SPINNING DISK MOTOR also changes public 22 (#22 SPINNING DISK MOTOR RELAY); firing #24 OPTIONAL COIL changes no public solenoid.

source.attribution: Generated locally from pinned PinMAME and the user-authorized ROM corpus; ROM bytes remain external. Public switch writes are host stimuli, never ROM observations. The runner can checkpoint only segment-display text, so the DMD service-menu navigation is counted key pulses; every retained DMD frame cited here was read visually and each diagnostic snapshot's interpreted_text is that reading of its pixel SHA-256. Exact external directory manifest coil-sweep-nba_600/manifest.json SHA-256 1d8619f5e611fc6343387977b283cd1f750ab786e7bb5a16de57c1f736e8dc84 (built by tools/build_external_evidence_manifest.py); it lists the raw trace, the copied scenario, the DMD frames and the isolated mutable state, with no ROM bytes.
